title: Copying Words

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Brother Thomas is teaching the village children to write. He's asked you to help make their first copy cards.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Listen to each word, and set its letters in order, neatly.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: Every card ready. The children will learn to write from your letters!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Your letters will teach others to write. That's how learning travels: from one hand to the next.

journal_line: I made copy cards for the village children in the scriptorium.
